newsitem.title: UK: Air Canada handles more European tonnage.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada handles more European tonnage.

text.p: Air Canada said it is handling more cargo in Europe and increasing its revenues from doing so.
In June it handled a record tonnage at its two Heathrow cargo terminals and expects to set a new peak this month, its cargo general manager for Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Des Vertannes said.

In June it handled 7,961 tonnes of imports and exports and Vertannes said this should go above 8,000 tonnes in July, even allowing for the fact that since last month Air Canada is no longer handling cargo for Continental Airlines at Heathrow.
Air Canada's own flights accounted for 4,500 tonnes of the June Heathrow total.
Other main customers at Heathrow in June were Gulf Air at 1,500 tonnes, Royal Jordanian 500 tonnes, Continental Airlines 650 tonnes and Air China 400 tonnes.
For all Europe, Air Canada's earnings for handling cargo in January-May this year were 18 percent up on the first five months of last year.
For May, earnings were 23 percent higher on tonnage that was up 28 percent. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
